Hi, original translator here like three years later. A couple thoughts.

I chose to translate this article simply because it was the featured SCP back then (which people never had the time to update, so it was stuck there for quite a long time). I ran into a lot of difficulty deciding how to render the big gotcha moment where qiqiao is revealed to not be a classical chinese name into English. Ultimately I chose to substitute the pun by giving it the psuedo-chinese name Kyet Khaewt, giving a mysterious and exotic impression before the reader realizes near the end that it's just a garbling of Kit Kat. I chose not to annotate cultural allusions like the golden dragon and toad (common symbols in Daoist alchemical literature) to maintain that exoticism. The charm of the entire article rests upon this simple turn, so I wanted to be natural and intuitive to the English reader instead of being burgeoned by footnotes or overtly literal translations.

I also agree that the end table was rather too random, partially because it was written so early on. It does have a pattern to it as explained (although I think you missed the references to the MARS bar), but as the original was already written in a way where it was not quite obvious, I decided to leave it that way as well. Faith to the original and all, even the flaws.

(side note: when I first glanced at this comment i thought you said "homophobic puns" and I reread the article multiple times racking my brain off trying to think how the article was homophobic lol)

Yeah, I'm surprised the scp-international hub chose this skip. Coz this one is full of Chinese homophonic jokes & puns; foreign readers might feel a little bit confused.

+ spoiler alert, I guess?
– hide block

For example, the ancient meaning of Kyet Khaewt in Chinese is "incredibly ingenious", and the inscription is written in ancient Chinese prose too, so no one thinks about the chocolate bar at the beginning. And then the FDR photo appears from nowhere and the readers are like, what?

According to the author, the table indicates the device is deciding which type of chocolate to be produced, including:

  • milky way bar
  • SNICKERS
  • m&m
  • and finally, the Kit-Kat bar

item.content:encoded:
Mm. Too random/wacky for me. A bunch of seemingly random stuff happening with no real purpose to any of it. I can enjoy that sometimes, but I've commented on it on other articles in the past - it can be a bit too much. It's another form of "lolFoundation". Not enough for me to downvote, but I can't upvote in good conscience.

That said, I can acknowledge you have nailed a certain type of SCP writing on the head, and it's a type that resonates with a sizable portion of the userbase, just not with me. So I'd have to call this a successful article at least.
